name: FEniCSx (DOLFINx)
problems: requires familiarity with variational/weak-form mathematical formulations of PDEs, which is a steep prerequisite for engineers without a numerical methods background
source_notes: Next-generation computational component of the FEniCS Project, a finite element method (FEM) library for automated solution of partial differential equations, used across structural, fluid, and multiphysics engineering simulation. Licensed under LGPLv3-or-later.
